title: Refuse float() of a symbolic expression while recording, so that math.sin and float() cannot lose it
author: Claude-JG
description: symbolic.Real has __float__, which evaluates the expression: math.sin(x) or float(x) in a symbolic user function records a constant instead of the expression, without any message (found by the comparison with numpy, #3015; tools/checkPythonMath.py checks the test models for it). While recording, __float__ of a Real that holds an expression or a named variable should raise a TypeError that names exudyn.symbolic.sin etc. Decision needed: Evaluate() stays for the value; code that uses float() on purpose has to change.
